name: Toho Bank Ltd/The
summary: The Toho Bank, Ltd. functions as a financial institution providing a broad spectrum of banking solutions throughout Japan. Its product portfolio encompasses individual and institutional deposit accounts, negotiable certificates of deposit, credit card services, leasing options, and various loan types, including commercial and mortgage financing, along with discounted bills and credit guarantees. Beyond its primary banking activities, the company also engages in investments in marketable securities, the printing and binding of business documentation, and specialized calculation and software development operations. As of March 31, 2021, the bank maintained a network of 122 branches. The Toho Bank, Ltd. was founded in 1941 and is based in Fukushima, Japan.
